title: Plan review: the docked modal with the plan's markdown styled
description:
Per the map ticket 'Prototype: the modal for Plan review and the Epic summary' (harness-0sx.5), layout C Docked. Prototype: branch prototype/modal, src/shell/draw/prototype_modal.rs (cargo run -- __prototype-modal).

The Plan Question (Ask::Plan) leaves the Question box. The Shell keeps running in the left 42% (TICKETS, RECENT, status row, input line, all live) and the plan docks in the right 58% as a thick-bordered box titled 'PLAN · <suffix> <title>': a badge line (the Judgment's score, 'judged 0.62', when it had one; 'N more waiting' for the other Questions; 'N new on RECENT'), a one-line lead, the plan's markdown styled (h1 purple and underlined, h2 cyan, h3 bold; • and ◦ bullets and numbered items with hanging indents; > quotes muted italic; inline code orange on a tint; **bold**; fenced code on a tinted ground with + lines green, - lines red and @@ cyan), a scrollbar, and the options listed vertically at its foot. A small markdown-to-Lines function, no crate. The dock is a frame of its own: /config docks the same way (Ticket 9).

Fold: under 110 columns it becomes a rounded box over the dimmed Shell that fills the screen except the input line (with margins from 100x30 up), options in one row; under 100 columns the badges shorten ('judged 0.62', 'N new'), under 80 the option words do.

Keys while it shows: ↑↓ a line, PgUp/PgDn/Space a page, Home/End, Tab/Shift-Tab the next/previous heading, ←→ or 1-4 pick an option, Enter answers, Esc hides it, and Esc on an empty input line shows it again. Feedback of your own: that option's row becomes an input inside the modal ('feedback › …'); PgUp/PgDn keep scrolling the plan while typing; Enter sends (Answer::Prompt, as today), Esc goes back to the options.

Other Questions queue as today, one at a time, oldest first; the badge counts them; answering the plan shows the next (a Wake in the Shell's Question box, another plan in the modal). In the fold the badge counts the events since the modal opened.

The reasoning behind each decision is on the map's closed tickets: bd show harness-0sx.<n> --json --include-comments. Research notes and prototypes live on local branches: git show research/<name>:docs/research/<file>.md, git show prototype/<name>:<path>. Vocabulary: CONTEXT.md. Decisions: docs/adr/. Rust; crates limited to serde, serde_json, regex, chrono, crossterm, ratatui and ureq, anything else needs a ticket.
acceptance_criteria: TestBackend renders at 160x45 (docked), 100x30 and 80x24 (folded) of a sample plan with every markdown element. Key tests: Tab jumps to the next heading; PgDn moves a page; picking feedback and typing composes in the modal and Enter sends Answer::Prompt to the fake Orchestrator; Esc hides and Esc on an empty input shows; with a Wake queued behind, answering the plan shows the Wake in the Question box.
